verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents extended/adaptive thinking modes (always-on adaptive thinking, thinking:{"type":"disabled"} parameter noted as unavailable on Opus 5.5) and an explicit effort parameter that trades intelligence for latency/cost, plus fast mode for higher throughput at premium pricing — all documented request-level controls over 'how hard the model thinks'. Missing for 10: no explicit confidence-signal/verbosity parameter documented, and no independent hands-on benchmark validating the effort parameter's effect.
